(1) we have developed a novel evaluation of compositional morphology in distributional semantics, (2) the full additive compositional model outperforms a strong baseline, (3) the full additive model performs better than a model that uses only corpus-derived representations, (4) a model that uses a combination of compositional and corpus-derived representations outperforms the full compositional model.
